actions.name: Download the working version of the HD Videobox app (with settings already configured):
We also recommend downloading and installing an external media player, such as MX Player (available on Google Play) or Vimu Media Player.

Next, we need to transfer the APK files to our TV box. If your device has a USB port, you can simply copy the files using a USB flash drive. However, compact stick-style TV devices without USB ports are now very popular. That's why we'll look at a more universal, simple, and convenient way to transfer files to an Android TV box without using a USB flash drive.

name: Transferring files to your TV box

actions.name: On your TV box, open the Play Store and download the File Manager app. You can use any file manager that supports FTP transfers.
Download, install, and open the app. Select "Access from network".
Start the file access service over the network. Your computer and TV box must be connected to the same router, meaning they must be on the same network.

Return to your computer. Open "This PC" and enter the address shown in the app on your TV box into the address bar. (In the previous screenshot, the address is "ftp://192.168.1.97:3740". Your address will be different.) Then enter the username and password shown in the app. Your credentials will be different too; the screenshot is only an example.

A folder named "device" will then open on your computer (it may have a different name on your device). You can now access the files on your TV box from your computer. Open "device/download/" and drag the files you downloaded earlier into this folder.
Return to your TV box and use any file manager to find and open the "download" folder. You should see the files there.
As mentioned above, the files should be in the "Downloads" or "download" folder on your TV box.
You can install the Vimu Player app first by opening the Vimu+Media+Player.apk file.

Next, install the HD Videobox app and grant all the permissions requested during installation.
Open the app and go to Settings.
Select the external player you installed. In our example, this is "ViMu Player", but you can choose any other player you prefer.

How do you play a video? Here's an example.
Go to the main menu and use Search to find the movie you want. Its details page will open. Select the "VIDEO" tab.
Choose the video file with your preferred audio translation and open it. Playback will start.
